Today marks six months since the massacre of Iranian protesters during the January anti-regime uprising. 

This video is what shakes me up the most—the average person can’t make it past two minutes. It should be shown to atrocity deniers…
This one, you can hear gunshots almost nonstop. The protester says, "People have risen up. People have taken over the city, but they're shooting us with live ammunition."
